name: nimyaml-yamllsp
description: Lint diagnostics, JSON Schema validation and %GLOBAL/%SCHEMA directive support for YAML via NimYAML's yamllsp

nimyaml.yamllsp.path.markdownDescription: Command that starts the `yamllsp` language server: a name looked up on `PATH` or an absolute path. Build it with `nim yamllsp config.nims` in the NimYAML repository.

nimyaml.yamllsp.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server.

nimyaml.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and yamllsp in the output channel.
